summary: Linux 1.0.72: PROGRAM, M0863 identity and a valid NRK record, then no reply to 0x7C. KPG-76D 0x403110 sets a 3000 ms read timeout (SetCommTimeouts helper 0x401340, not a sleep), sends 0x7C immediately and reads 2 bytes; the driver slept 3 s and then allowed 1 s. CPS framing is 9600,N,8,2; the driver used even parity.
title: Read stops at 0x7C memory session: 0 of 2 bytes
